passages.text: Asa’s son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place, and he strengthened himself against Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was Asa’s son.
Asa was king before Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat became king after Asa died.
Jehoshaphat ruled in Asa’s place.
Jehoshaphat made himself strong against Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֖ק עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: He stationed troops in every fortified city of Judah and put garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was the king of Judah.
He was the son of Asa.
Jehoshaphat placed troops in every fortified city of Judah.
He put garrisons throughout the land of Judah.
He also put garrisons in the cities of Ephraim.
Asa, his father, had captured these cities of Ephraim.
passages.original: וַיִּ֨תֶּן־ חַ֔יִל בְּכָל־ עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה הַבְּצֻר֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֤ן נְצִיבִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבְעָרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד אָסָ֥א אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: Now the LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David. He did not seek out the Baals, but he sought the God of his father and walked by His commandments rather than the practices of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
The LORD was with Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat walked in the early ways of his ancestor David.
Jehoshaphat did not seek the Baals.
Jehoshaphat sought the God of his father.
Jehoshaphat followed God's commandments.
Jehoshaphat did not act like Israel.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י הָלַ֗ךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֞י דָּוִ֤יד אָבִיו֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א דָרַ֖שׁ לַבְּעָלִֽים׃ כִּ֠י לֵֽאלֹהֵ֤י אָבִיו֙ דָּרָ֔שׁ וּבְמִצְוֺתָ֖יו הָלָ֑ךְ וְלֹ֖א כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So the LORD established the kingdom in his hand, and all Judah brought him tribute, so that he had an abundance of riches and honor.
passages.sermon:
The LORD supported Jehoshaphat.
The LORD made Jehoshaphat strong as king.
All the people of Judah gave gifts to Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat received much wealth.
Jehoshaphat received much honor.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨כֶן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיִּתְּנ֧וּ כָל־ יְהוּדָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וַֽיְהִי־ ל֥וֹ עֹֽשֶׁר־ וְכָב֖וֹד לָרֹֽב׃

passages.text: And his heart took delight in the ways of the LORD; furthermore, he removed the high places and Asherah poles from Judah.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
He loved the ways of the LORD.
His heart took delight in following God.
He removed the high places from Judah.
He also took away the Asherah poles from Judah.
passages.original: וַיִּגְבַּ֥הּ לִבּ֖וֹ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְע֗וֹד הֵסִ֛יר אֶת־ הַבָּמ֥וֹת וְאֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֖ים מִיהוּדָֽה׃פ

passages.text: In the third year of his reign, Jehoshaphat sent his officials Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah to teach in the cities of Judah, accompanied by certain Levites—Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah—along with the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
He began to reign over Judah.
In the third year of his reign, Jehoshaphat acted.
Jehoshaphat sent his officials to the cities of Judah.
The officials were Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah.
Jehoshaphat sent these men to teach in the cities of Judah.
Certain Levites went with them.
The Levites were Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah.
Two priests also went with them.
The priests were Elishama and Jehoram.
These men went together to teach in the cities of Judah.
passages.original: וּבִשְׁנַ֨ת שָׁל֜וֹשׁ לְמָלְכ֗וֹ שָׁלַ֤ח לְשָׂרָיו֙ לְבֶן־ חַ֙יִל֙ וּלְעֹבַדְיָ֣ה וְלִזְכַרְיָ֔ה וְלִנְתַנְאֵ֖ל וּלְמִיכָיָ֑הוּ לְלַמֵּ֖ד בְּעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃ וְעִמָּהֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֗ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָ֡הוּ וּנְתַנְיָ֡הוּ וּזְבַדְיָ֡הוּ וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִרִימוֹת וִֽיהוֹנָתָן֩ וַאֲדֹ֨נִיָּ֧הוּ וְטֽוֹבִיָּ֛הוּ וְט֥וֹב אֲדוֹנִיָּ֖ה הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וִֽיהוֹרָ֖ם הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃

passages.text: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the LORD. They went throughout the towns of Judah and taught the people.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
He sent teachers throughout Judah.
The teachers carried the Book of the Law of the LORD.
They traveled to every town in Judah.
They taught the people in each town.
passages.original: וַֽיְלַמְּדוּ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְעִ֨מָּהֶ֔ם סֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּסֹ֙בּוּ֙ בְּכָל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיְלַמְּד֖וּ בָּעָֽם׃

passages.text: And the dread of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that surrounded Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was the king of Judah.
Many kingdoms surrounded Judah.
The LORD caused fear to fall on all these kingdoms.
These kingdoms did not attack Jehoshaphat.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ פַּ֣חַד יְהוָ֗ה עַ֚ל כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיב֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עִם־ יְהוֹשָׁפָֽט׃

passages.text: Some Philistines also brought gifts and silver as tribute to Jehoshaphat, and the Arabs brought him 7,700 rams and 7,700 goats from their flocks.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
Some Philistines brought gifts to Jehoshaphat.
They also brought him silver as tribute.
The Arabs brought animals to Jehoshaphat.
They brought him 7,700 rams.
They also brought him 7,700 goats.
passages.original: וּמִן־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים מְבִיאִ֧ים לִֽיהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט מִנְחָ֖ה וְכֶ֣סֶף מַשָּׂ֑א גַּ֣ם הָֽעַרְבִיאִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֥ים לוֹ֙ צֹ֕אן אֵילִ֔ים שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וּשְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וּתְיָשִׁ֕ים שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: Jehoshaphat grew stronger and stronger, and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah and kept vast supplies in the cities of Judah. He also had warriors in Jerusalem who were mighty men of valor.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was the king of Judah.
Jehoshaphat became stronger and stronger.
He built fortresses in Judah.
He built store cities in Judah.
He kept many supplies in the cities of Judah.
He had warriors in Jerusalem.
These warriors were mighty men of valor.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֧י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְגָדֵ֖ל עַד־ לְמָ֑עְלָה וַיִּ֧בֶן בִּֽיהוּדָ֛ה בִּירָנִיּ֖וֹת וְעָרֵ֥י מִסְכְּנֽוֹת׃ וּמְלָאכָ֥ה רַבָּ֛ה הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאַנְשֵׁ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: These are their numbers according to the houses of their fathers: From Judah, the commanders of thousands: Adnah the commander, and with him 300,000 mighty men of valor; next to him, Jehohanan the commander, and with him 280,000; and next to him, Amasiah son of Zichri, the volunteer for the LORD, and with him 200,000 mighty men of valor.
passages.sermon:
Jehoshaphat was king in Judah.
He had commanders and soldiers under him.
These are the numbers of the men from Judah.
Adnah was a commander.
Adnah led 300,000 mighty men of valor.
Jehohanan was another commander.
Jehohanan led 280,000 men.
Amasiah was the son of Zichri.
Amasiah volunteered to serve the LORD.
Amasiah led 200,000 mighty men of valor.
passages.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם לִֽיהוּדָה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י אֲלָפִ֔ים עַדְנָ֣ה הַשָּׂ֔ר וְעִמּוֹ֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל־ יָד֖וֹ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַשָּׂ֑ר וְעִמּ֕וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל־ יָדוֹ֙ עֲמַסְיָ֣ה בֶן־ זִכְרִ֔י הַמִּתְנַדֵּ֖ב לַיהוָ֑ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָֽיִל׃ס

passages.text: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him 200,000 armed with bows and shields; and next to him, Jehozabad, and with him 180,000 armed for battle.
passages.sermon:
Eliada came from the tribe of Benjamin.
Eliada was a mighty man of valor.
Eliada had 200,000 men with him.
These men carried bows and shields.
Jehozabad stood next to Eliada.
Jehozabad had 180,000 men with him.
These men were armed for battle.
passages.original: וּמִ֨ן־ בִּנְיָמִ֔ן גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֖יִל אֶלְיָדָ֑ע וְעִמּ֛וֹ נֹֽשְׁקֵי־ קֶ֥שֶׁת וּמָגֵ֖ן מָאתַ֥יִם אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל־ יָד֖וֹ יְהוֹזָבָ֑ד וְעִמּ֛וֹ מֵאָֽה־ וּשְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃ס

passages.text: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.
passages.sermon: These men served the king.\r\nThe king also placed other men in the fortified cities.\r\nThese fortified cities were in all of Judah.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה הַמְשָׁרְתִ֣ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ מִלְּבַ֞ד אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ בְּעָרֵ֥י הַמִּבְצָ֖ר בְּכָל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃פ
